author: Undecided with Matt Ferrell
description:
How We Can Turn Desert Air Into Drinking Water. Head over to https://eightsleep.com/mattferrell and use the code MATT to get $200 off the new Pod 6. With solar on your roof and a battery in your garage, you can make your own power today. Water is the one essential you still have to buy. Now a machine pulls water from air so dry it could give you a nosebleed. The secret is a metal organic framework, a powder so remarkable that Omar Yaghi shared a Nobel Prize for pioneering it. His company Atoco says one shipping-container-sized unit can make up to 4,000 liters a day, and that water could reach places too far inland for desalination. So is this machine actually the water breakthrough solar and batteries were missing? Or is it just a very expensive science experiment?
